snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer: The Last Zeppelin #indiegame #gameplay #arcadegames  #steam
snippet.description:
Gameplay trailer of "The Last Zeppelin". A casual, retro-inspired 2D shooter with an alt-history twist! Pilot the last German Zeppelin in a parallel universe against a reptilian army. Master your Zero-Energy Impulse and blast through double-deckers and flying saucers. Simple controls, escalating difficulty, and pure arcade action.

Wishlist the game on Steam, Play the Demo: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4601080/The_Last_Zeppelin/
